mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia which increase tacrolimus nephrotoxicity and cardiotoxicity; both drugs are nephrotoxic and tacrolimus is CYP3A4-metabolized with potential for altered clearance.
action: Monitor serum potassium, magnesium, and creatinine closely; consider alternative antihypertensive agent or potassium-sparing diuretic; maintain tacrolimus levels within therapeutic range.
